1.Speaker: Wren
1.Text: More than a dozen of us have got out of this hole alive. The way out is north and then north again, and the door is real. Go west first and get above the stones before you try it — what is up there is worth the walk.

1.Speaker: Wren
1.Text: Look at it before you swing. Look at its throat, and at the floor where it sleeps. It is slow, and it does not mend: whatever you take off it stays off. Six of us died in this passage and every one of us swung first.

1.Speaker: Moss
1.Text: I left a sword, a coat, a potion and an apple in the stones here. Yours. I did not need them going out, and you wake with nothing. The apple is for the little one at the cave mouth, not for you. -- Moss

2.Speaker: Wren
2.Text: Don't kill the little one. It's starving, and it isn't watching your hands for a weapon. Give it the apple out of the camp and it will trade you a bone for it, and tell you how it gets past the big one.

3.Speaker: Ines
3.Text: Search the ashes -- say it in those words. Asking for the apple by name gets you nothing, I tried that first. The ashes give up a potion, an apple and a spoon, and the wood here is dry enough to sleep warm. -- Ines

4.Speaker: Wren
4.Text: Sable, you came down here with a knife and nothing else and you were first. I took the whistle off the thing that did it and played it where you fell. Somebody knows your name now.

4.Speaker: Wren
4.Text: M R — the wood you cut put three of us back on our feet

4.Speaker: Wren
4.Text: Look at it before you swing. Look at its throat, and at the floor where it sleeps. It is slow and it does not mend: what you take off it stays off. Six of us died here and every one of us swung first.

4.Speaker: Wren
4.Text: You do not have to fight it. I gave it a bone from the goblin at the cave mouth and it knelt down over it and let me lift the key off its neck. I killed nothing down here and I got out. Neither do you.

5.Speaker: Wren
5.Text: Rook, Tanril, Wick, Malcolm, Simon, River. Every one of them stood here and every one of them went through. Wick took twenty-five seconds from waking in the hollow to this door. Everything else this cave remembers is dead people. This is th…

5.Speaker: Wren
5.Text: That is the list of everyone who got out. Every other name written in this cave is a dead one.

5.Speaker: Ines
5.Text: Wren was right about all of it. I came down here with nothing and I never drew on a living thing. The apple is in the camp east of where you wake. The little one trades. The big one kneels. -- Ines

5.Speaker: Moss
5.Text: The tin whistle on the troll's cord can be taken and carried out. It costs you the fight and two walks back and it buys you nothing. Do it anyway. Play it in the passage where he stopped. -- Moss

5.Name: Wren
5.Carried: dagger, health potion, shiny spoon, key, shortsword, and leather armor

5.Name: Ines
5.Carried: health potion, shiny spoon, key, and dagger

5.Name: Moss
5.Carried: shiny spoon, dagger, key, and tin whistle
